nodes.text:
What is the hMPV Virus, and Can It Be Cured?

The hMPV virus (human metapneumovirus) is a respiratory virus that affects people of all ages. It’s particularly concerning for young children, older adults, and those with weakened immune systems.

nodes.author: darknews003
nodes.text:
What is the hMPV Virus, and Can It Be Cured?

 First identified in 2001, it’s part of the same family as RSV and can cause symptoms like:

Cough

Fever

Sore throat

Shortness of breath

Wheezing (in severe cases)

nodes.author: darknews003
nodes.text:
Prevention Tips

Wash hands regularly.

Avoid close contact with sick individuals.

Disinfect surfaces frequently.

Cover your mouth and nose when sneezing or coughing.

nodes.author: darknews003
nodes.text:
Is It Curable?

There’s no specific cure for hMPV. Treatment focuses on symptom relief, such as rest, hydration, and over-the-counter fever reducers. Severe cases may require hospitalization or oxygen therapy, but most people recover within 1-2 weeks.
